vulnerabilities.name: MS17-010 EternalBlue
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply Microsoft patch MS17-010 and disable SMBv1 where possible.

vulnerabilities.name: MS08-067 NetAPI32 RCE
vulnerabilities.remediation: Install the MS08-067 security update and isolate legacy Windows hosts.

vulnerabilities.name: SMB Relay (NTLM) / Signing Disabled
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enable SMB signing and enforce SMBv2+ across the domain.

vulnerabilities.name: OpenSSH User Enumeration
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to a patched release (>= 7.7 on affected distros).

vulnerabilities.name: SSH Weak Credentials
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce key-based authentication and disable password login.

vulnerabilities.name: Directory Bruteforce
vulnerabilities.remediation: Harden web root permissions and review exposed directories.

vulnerabilities.name: Apache Path Traversal / Traversal
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade Apache to >= 2.4.50 with the access-control fix applied.

vulnerabilities.name: Log4Shell (Log4j RCE)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1+ or apply the mitigation flag JVM_OPT='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true'.

vulnerabilities.name: OpenSSL Heartbleed
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL and revoke any keys potentially exposed via heartbeat.

vulnerabilities.name: Log4Shell (Log4j RCE)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1+ and scan for nested libraries using vulnerable versions.

vulnerabilities.name: Weak TLS Cipher Suite
vulnerabilities.remediation: Disable SSLv3/TLSv1.0 and enforce modern cipher suites.

vulnerabilities.name: vsftpd 2.3.4 Backdoor
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade vsftpd and block access from untrusted networks.

vulnerabilities.name: FTP Anonymous Login
vulnerabilities.remediation: Disable anonymous FTP access and enforce strong credentials.

vulnerabilities.name: MySQL Authentication Bypass
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade MySQL/MariaDB and restrict the service to trusted hosts.

vulnerabilities.name: MySQL Weak Credentials
vulnerabilities.remediation: Set strong passwords and disable remote root access.

vulnerabilities.name: PostgreSQL Superuser Command Execution
vulnerabilities.remediation: Revoke the pg_execute_server_program role from non-admin users.

vulnerabilities.name: PostgreSQL Weak Credentials
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce strong passwords and IP-level access control in pg_hba.conf.

vulnerabilities.name: BlueKeep (RDP RCE)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply the BlueKeep security update and enable Network Level Authentication.

vulnerabilities.name: RDP Exposed / Weak Auth
vulnerabilities.remediation: Disable RDP from the internet or put it behind a VPN and enforce NLA.

vulnerabilities.name: SNMP Default Community String
vulnerabilities.remediation: Change community strings from 'public'/'private' and restrict SNMP by ACL.

vulnerabilities.name: SNMP Credential Bruteforce
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use long, random community strings and SNMPv3 with auth/privacy.

vulnerabilities.name: Redis Unauthenticated RCE
vulnerabilities.remediation: Require authentication, bind to loopback, and disable dangerous commands.

vulnerabilities.name: Redis Weak Password
vulnerabilities.remediation: Set a strong requirepass value and disable CONFIG on untrusted clients.

vulnerabilities.name: MSSQL Weak Credentials
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce strong SA passwords and Windows Authentication mode.

vulnerabilities.name: MSSQL Command Execution via xp_cmdshell
vulnerabilities.remediation: Disable xp_cmdshell and grant least-privilege SQL accounts.

vulnerabilities.name: VNC Authentication Bypass
vulnerabilities.remediation: Patch VNC servers and require strong, non-empty passwords.

vulnerabilities.name: VNC Weak Password
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use long passwords and connect over an encrypted tunnel.

vulnerabilities.name: SMTP User Enumeration (VRFY/EXPN)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Disable VRFY/EXPN and rate-limit SMTP connections.

vulnerabilities.name: OpenSMTPD RCE
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade OpenSMTPD to a patched version immediately.

vulnerabilities.name: Telnet Weak Credentials
vulnerabilities.remediation: Replace Telnet with SSH and enforce strong credentials.

vulnerabilities.name: MongoDB Authentication Disabled
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enable MongoDB authentication and bind to loopback/private networks only.

vulnerabilities.name: Docker Remote API Unauthenticated
vulnerabilities.remediation: Never expose the Docker API unauthenticated; use TLS and bind to loopback.

vulnerabilities.name: NFS Mount Misconfiguration
vulnerabilities.remediation: Export with root_squash and restrict to trusted hosts in /etc/exports.
